visual_action: A two-panel meme. The first panel shows a smiling photo of Donald Trump with the text "when your card declines at therapy". The second panel shows a photo of Donald Trump on a golf course wearing a red "MAKE AMERICA GREAT AGAIN" hat, looking distressed. Two teardrop emojis are superimposed on his face, and the text reads "so they bring up how you lost the 2020 election".

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: He is the subject of the meme, shown in two different photos, and the on-screen text refers to his loss of the 2020 election.

on_screen_text.text: when your card declines at therapy
so they bring up how you lost the 2020 election

spoken_summary: A male vocalist sings softly over an acoustic guitar. The audible lyrics are "Marceline... Is it just you and me in the wreckage of the world?"
audio_music: A slow, melancholic acoustic guitar song plays throughout the video, creating a sad and mocking tone. The music is identified as "marceline" by TAK.
editing_pacing: A static slideshow with two images.
manipulation_or_satire: Two teardrop emojis are superimposed over Donald Trump's face in the second image to make it appear as if he is crying, for a mocking effect.
cultural_references: The video uses a common two-panel meme format juxtaposing a positive setup with a negative punchline.
The song is titled 'marceline', which may be a reference to the character Marceline the Vampire Queen from the animated TV show 'Adventure Time'.
central_claim: Donald Trump is emotionally upset and fixated on his 2020 election loss.
intended_effect: To mock Donald Trump and portray him as emotionally fragile regarding his election loss.
